festivals.title: APAP Artwork Tour
festivals.overview: The Anyang Public Art Project (APAP) started in 2005 and has led to the creation of many beautiful works of art that decorate the city's public spaces. The Anyang Foundation for Culture & Arts has created a tour program to explore the wonderful works, starting from the earliest works in 2005 up until now.

festivals.overview:
Ssokssokdeul-i Festival is a program organized by the National Theater of Korea’s Stage Arts Support Center, designed to make performing arts more accessible in everyday life. Held regularly throughout the year, it offers a variety of performances free of charge, creating greater opportunities for the public to engage with the arts in a relaxed and approachable setting.

festivals.title: Hantangang Garden Festa
festivals.overview: The Hantangang Garden Festa is a large-scale ecological and garden festival themed around seasonal flowers and nature, held at the Pocheon Hantangang River Ecological Landscape Complex. It is a festival where visitors can enjoy the thrill of a 410-meter-long Y-shaped suspension bridge along with the vast natural landscapes of the Hantangang River region, a registered UNESCO World Geopark. festivals.title: Gyeonggi Ceramics Biennale
festivals.overview: The Gyeonggi Ceramics Biennale features a range of exhibitions and educational events. The event takes place at various locations in Korea famous for ceramics, including Icheon, Yeoju, and Gwangju.

festivals.title: Han River Walk
festivals.overview: The Han River Walk is a walking event that takes place at various locations along the Hangang River. Participants can expect to enjoy light exercise in beautiful natural settings, as well as earn a completion medal. In addition to walking, the festival dates will feature a range of additional events for a lively environment.

festivals.title: Goyang Autumn Flower Festival
festivals.overview: Goyang Autumn Flower Festival is an annual festival featuring autumn flowers like chrysanthemums, cosmos, sunflowers, and zinnias. VIsitors can enjoy autumn to the fullest with the flowers at their peak in the garden and flower artworks in the indoor exhibition hall. The festival also offers various performances, flower market and traditional experiences.

festivals.title: Suwon Hwaseong Festival
festivals.overview: The Suwon Hwaseong Cultural Festival reimagines, through a contemporary lens, the most magnificent moments of King Jeongjo’s eight-day royal procession to Hwaseong in 1795. Historic scenes recorded in the Wonhaeng Eulmyo Jeongni Uigwe come vividly to life through high-quality cultural programs. Visitors can also take part in the King Jeongjo Royal Parade, the largest royal procession reenactment in Korea, where citizens and guests from around the world become part of the spectacle. festivals.title: GHOST Festival (Gyeonggi Hallyu OST Festival)
festivals.overview: The Gyeonggi Hallyu OST Music Festival, or the GHOST Festival, is Korea’s first festival dedicated to original soundtracks. It brings together the memorable music of K-dramas, films, and animation alongside performances by renowned K-pop artists. The festival unfolds across a series of themed programs including romance, science fiction, and fantasy. Each day presents a rich spectrum of performances, from lyrical ballads and dynamic band music to grand orchestral compositions. festivals.title: Icheon Ginseng Festival
festivals.overview: The Icheon Ginseng Festival has been held annually since 2015 to promote the benefits and value of the locally grown ginseng. The festival features sales as well as events.

festivals.title: Korea AI Content Awards
festivals.overview: Hosted by Gyeonggi Province and organized by the Gyeonggi Content Agency, the Korea AI Content Awards is an event designed to discover new possibilities for creativity through the convergence of generative AI technology and video content, and to collectively explore the future of the content industry in the AI era. Held at Lotte Cinema Suwon, this awards ceremony will feature a variety of AI video works submitted from both Korea and abroad. festivals.title: Dasan Jeong Yak-yong Culture Festival
festivals.overview: The Dasan Jeong Yak-yong Cultural Festival is themed around the life of Jeong Yak-yong (penname Dasan). The festival takes place in the area surrounding the Jeong Yak-yong Historic Site and Dasan Ecological Park. During the festival, various performances and hands-on programs will be prepared for visitors. In addition, busking performances and markets are held at Dasan Ecological Park, and it is a festival where you can experience Jeong Yak-yong's historical and cultural content, performances, and hands-on activities together.

festivals.title: Yeoju Ogoknaru Festival
festivals.overview: The 2026 Yeoju Ogoknaru Festival celebrates Yeoju's traditional culture and history, harking back to a time when local specialties such as rice and sweet potatoes were shipped from Jopo Quay as tribute offerings to the royal court during the Joseon dynasty. Highlights include the Royal Tribute Parade, Bibimbap with Cast-Iron-Pot-Cooked Yeoju Rice, Roasted Sweet Potato Guinness, Wish Paper Trail, and Nakhwanori, along with local produce markets, food stalls, traditional cultural activities, and performances. festivals.title: Oh Slow Vintage Market

Professional vintage sellers from across the country gather to showcase special items containing their unique tastes and stories, including vintage fashion, antique objects, retro accessories, and handicrafts.
